query:
INSERT INTO revenueEntries (saleId, revenueAccountId, amount, entryType, description, entryDate)
SELECT 
  s.id as saleId,
  s.revenueAccountId,
  CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(COALESCE(s.discountAmount, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as amount,
  'CREDITO' as entryType,
  CONCAT('Venda #', s.id, ' - ', s.saleType) as description,
  s.saleDate as entryDate
FROM sales s
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND s.revenueAccountId IS NOT NULL
  AND s.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT saleId FROM revenueEntries);
